name: mio-integration-combined-arm-template
notes: The combined arm w1_010_shock10_cal_hedge_lp (calibration with the two-regressor no-intercept map, plus the program hedge) and its control w1_010_shock10_cal_hedge_warm_lp (twin_warm with regressors 2, no hedge). Needs the pinned walk's read 1, read 2 and read 2b PASS and the hedge evidence open (G2, G3, G4). The hedge and the walk's direction part must price the Greeks alike or the study refuses `block_params_disagree`: the walk's direction block needs rate 0.0, iv_source mid, iv_disagree_tol 0.05, min_years 0.001, vol_floor 0.01 and the same parity params as hedge_parity (configs/edge-calibration-template.json ships 0.5 / 0.002 / 5 strikes: change it BEFORE the walk runs). Template, not a run config: nothing here is approved to run. RE-ENTRY Do-not list obeyed: development seal 2021-07-01 (no decision, fill, quote, mark or settlement at or past it; 2021Q3 and later never), no 2024+ data, no run log read, agents report counts, hashes and verdict words only. Every arm is a research arm BESIDE the nine locked formulations (A0010) on a NEW method id; the base formulation is w1_010_shock10_lp, its spec copied verbatim; locked_method_ids is the nine of the queue config. Copy this file to a new name, replace every item of `placeholders` and nothing else. PREREQUISITES in order: (1) diagnostics first, no solve: the ADR-0310 Greeks diagnostics on the saved selection-quarter runs, `PYTHONPATH=.:children/index_options python -m dskit.pipeline run <mio-greeks-<quarter>.json> --asof <date>`; (2) the arm is declared in docs/decisioning/attempts.jsonl BEFORE its first solve (family mio_integration); (3) `PYTHONPATH=.:children/index_options python -m dskit.pipeline validate <doc>.json`. RUN COMMAND (repository root, one document at a time): `PYTHONPATH=.:children/index_options python -m dskit.pipeline run <doc>.json --asof <quarter end>` (2021-06-30 for 2021Q2, then 2021-03-31 for 2021Q1, then 2020-03-31 for 2020Q1; exit 0 ran, 1 error or a refusal code, 3 halted). EVIDENCE: only the statuses `closed` or `insufficient` exist on the selection quarters (ADR-0313 section E); a quarter counts for a calibrated arm only with at least min_warm_weeks warm decision weeks; nothing here adopts an arm.

placeholders.meaning: the onboarding pin of the published edge maps (acquire once, after the walk's read words are PASS)
the adopted hedge ratio from the hedge evidence reads
the explicit StudyProtocolControl freeze of the quarter packet (run.template.json's substitutions)
